title: docs: state the interactive folder-trust exception wherever Moe still says it never opens a file inside a Claude config folder
description:
Follow-up to task-7a0b188151a74356a4965b3cc589eddf. That task lets scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs set `projects[<key>].hasTrustDialogAccepted` in an interactive seat's leased account `.claude.json`; a human signed off on 2026-10-26 (see that task's comments). It updates scripts/CLAUDE.md and docs/MCP_SERVER.md "Claude Account Rotation" itself. Three other places still state the old absolute rule and become false once it lands:
- docs/SCHEMA.md, the `claude-accounts/<id>/` entry: "Moe ... never opens a file inside it".
- packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/registry.ts, the header comment ("nothing here, or anywhere in Moe, opens a file inside it") and the accountConfigDir doc comment ("it never reads inside it").
- docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md "Claude Account Rotation Issues" has no entry for the new MOE_ACCOUNT_TRUST_GRANTED / MOE_ACCOUNT_UNTRUSTED codes.

The daemon-only statements stay true and must NOT change: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md, state/accountStore.ts. Take the exact wording (refusal reasons, codes, remedy) from the landed helper and scripts/CLAUDE.md. Do not paraphrase them.
definitionOfDone: docs/SCHEMA.md (claude-accounts/<id>/ entry) and packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/registry.ts (header comment and accountConfigDir comment) state the one exception: for an interactive claude seat, the wrapper helper scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs sets projects[<key>].hasTrustDialogAccepted in that account's .claude.json; the daemon and the accounts CLI still open nothing inside the folder.

docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md 'Claude Account Rotation Issues' lists MOE_ACCOUNT_TRUST_GRANTED and MOE_ACCOUNT_UNTRUSTED, every refusal reason the landed helper prints (verbatim), and the remedy (start claude once in the project under that account and accept the trust dialog).

The daemon-only statements (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md, src/state/accountStore.ts) are unchanged; git grep -n 'opens a file inside' shows no remaining absolute claim about all of Moe.
cd packages/moe-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 (comment-only daemon change) and npm run lint passes at the repo root.

implementationPlan.description: In docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md 'Claude Account Rotation Issues', add MOE_ACCOUNT_TRUST_GRANTED (key set; already trusted is quiet) and MOE_ACCOUNT_UNTRUSTED entries. Copy all TRUST_REASON values verbatim from landed helper: 'no .claude.json in the account folder'; "the account's .claude.json is not a regular file"; "the account's .claude.json is over 16 MiB"; "the account's .claude.json is not a JSON object"; "the account's .claude.json is locked by another claude"; "the account's .claude.json could not be rewritten"; 'the trust entry did not read back'; 'the launch directory is outside the project'. Copy canonical refusal/retry behavior and remedy: start claude once in the project under that account and accept the trust dialog. Describe error handling without suggesting credential edits, bypass flags or trust for headless seats; preserve the exact scope/security wording from landed docs.

Create scripts/tests/account-trust-docs.test.mjs using node:test/assert and read-only source text. Extract the bounded TRUST_REASON object from scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs without executing source; assert extraction is complete/nonempty and every quoted value appears literally in the troubleshooting section, together with both codes and stated remedy. Assert each of the three revised locations names interactive wrapper-only .claude.json/hasTrustDialogAccepted exception and retains daemon/accounts-CLI boundary; check protected daemon-only statements still exist. Use section/function-comment boundaries rather than global word-presence assertions or whole-doc snapshots. Test paths via import.meta.url for Windows/Unix; no real accounts, environment secrets or live claude calls.
